meta.name: ended
meta.description: Ended save: refused the plea, ended on the walked-away Ending.

payload.text:
Rain has followed you for three days along the old road. When the roofs of
Ashford finally rise out of the mist, the village bell is ringing, though it
is neither noon nor dusk.

A grey-haired woman in a mud-spattered apron hurries across the green
towards you, the bell rope still swinging behind her.

"You carry a weapon and you came by the woods road," she says. "Then you
are either very brave or very lost. I am Brenna, elder of Ashford. Will you
hear me out?"
Shake your head and keep walking.

Brenna's shoulders drop. She says nothing more as you pass the last
cottage.

payload.title: The Road Goes On
payload.text:
You turn your collar up against the rain and leave Ashford to its grief.
For years afterwards, travellers speak of the woods that whisper a girl's
name.
